body: claimed: Antigravity (uma) · 2026-11-16T20:16Z · branch mkinney:issue/2217-camcraft-gcode · plan: create pure-Rust camcraft-gcode crate parsing 3-axis RS-274/ISO 6983 programs into cl::Toolpath sections and a 1-based line map

Stopped in Step 7 (gate failed twice because `upstream/main` is currently broken at `e808c9629`).

What failed:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` falls back to `batch` because adding `camcraft-gcode` changes `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`.
- Both runs failed in step `[01] debug build (--no-run)` compiling `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs` (`CuttingRow` literal missing `stepdown` and `stepover`, `material` expected `Option<WorkMaterial>`). That pre-existing breakage on `upstream/main` is tracked in #2244 and fixed by open PR #2263 (unmerged at stop time).

What is ready and verified on `mkinney:issue/2217-camcraft-gcode` (commit `711314efd`):
- `camcraft-gcode` crate (`crates/gcode/`), depending only on `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-geometry`, and `thiserror`, with `docs/decisions/2217-camcraft-gcode.md` and `xtask/src/plan.rs` + `xtask/src/tests.rs` updated.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets`: 9 passed (7 in `gcode_3axis`, 2 in `dialects_and_planes`), 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-gcode -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with 0 warnings.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 153 passed (147 unit, 3 `merge_ready_skill`, 3 `review_artifacts`).
- Mutation checks verified red then green for `require_unit`, `G41`/`G42`, `R` full circle, missing `G28`/`G30` reference, `G65` macro refusal, and `R < 0` major/minor arc sign.

Releasing `claimed` now. Once #2244 / PR #2263 merges to `upstream/main`, merge `upstream/main` into `mkinney:issue/2217-camcraft-gcode`, re-run `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, and open the draft PR.
